items.title: Meta Andromeda: Powering the Next Generation of Ads Retrieval Through Model-System Co-Design
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「大模型训练、推理、RAG、后训练或评测」。原文摘要显示：This post describes the next generation of Meta Andromeda, Meta’s personalized ads retrieval engine, and how co-designing the model, system, and GPU hardware unlocks a new efficiency frontier for ads retrieval. In…
items.insightText: 重点看数据采集、链路诊断、排序指标和线上一致性校验，判断是否可迁移到地址 Agent 自进化架构。
